
## fastp Sequencing Quality

Upstream fastp removes adapters and low-quality reads. Statistics summarize duplication, Q30, GC content, retained reads and adapter trimming. Q30 is the percentage of bases with Phred score >= 30. Filtering charts retain the read-count categories; quality curves show mean Phred scores by cycle for R1 and R2. The key-figure PDF mode uses after-filtering stages, while full mode retains all stages.

```{python}
#| label: fastp-table
#| results: asis
data_path = input_files['fastp_stats_file']
display_fastp_table(data_path)
display_result_ai('rna.qc.fastp__table')
```
